Resource.Title: New comment on your resource
Resource.Content: Someone commented on a resource you published

Upload.FileUploadSuccessContent: Your file {file_name} has been stored. Thank you for sharing.
Upload.ResourcePublishedContent: Your resource is published with {file_count} file(s): {file_names}
Upload.FileUploadFailedTitle: File did not pass the check
Upload.FileCheckFailedContent: Your file {file_name} did not pass the check: {reason}. {missing_volumes, select, none {} other {Missing volumes: {missing_volumes}. }}Check the file and upload it again.
Upload.FileCheckStalledTitle: A file could not be checked
Upload.FileCheckStalledContent: The check of your file {file_name} failed several times and has been handed to an administrator. No action is needed for now.
Upload.FileCheckStalledAdminTitle: The check of a file has been paused
Upload.FileCheckStalledAdminContent: The check of {file_name}, uploaded by {uploader_name}, failed {failures} times in a row and has been paused. The last error: {last_error}. Handle it before {review_deadline}; after that the file is removed.
Upload.FileVirusReviewPendingContent: Your file {file_name} was flagged by the malware scan ({detected_viruses}) and sent to manual review (case #{malware_case_id}), to be finished by {review_deadline}
Upload.FileVirusReviewRequiredTitle: A file is waiting for malware review
Upload.FileVirusReviewRequiredContent: The file {file_name} uploaded by {uploader_name} was flagged by the malware scan ({detected_viruses}), case #{malware_case_id}. Handle it by {review_deadline}.
Upload.FileVirusFalsePositiveReleasedContent: Your file {file_name} (case #{malware_case_id}) was reviewed as a false positive and is available again.{review_note, select, none {} other { Reviewer's note: {review_note}}}
Upload.FileVirusConfirmedDeletedContent: Your file {file_name} (case #{malware_case_id}) was confirmed as harmful and has been deleted. You have uploaded harmful files {upload_injected_file_times} time(s); at {malware_auto_ban_threshold} in a row your account will be banned.{review_note, select, none {} other { Reviewer's note: {review_note}}}

Reupload.FileReuploadedTitle: A file of a game you favorited was updated
Reupload.FileReuploadedContent: The file {file_name} of {game_title}, a game you favorited, was updated.{reason, select, none {} other { Note: {reason}}}

Compose.DoneContent: Your composition is finished and the resource is published: {file_name}
Compose.RebuiltContent: The resource was composed again with the new patch: {file_name}
Compose.FailedContent: The composition of {file_name} could not be completed: {reason}

Block.Title: Comment did not pass moderation
Block.Content: Your comment did not pass moderation. Reason: {top_category}. Edit it and post it again.
Block.ReviewContent: Your comment did not pass moderation. Reason: {top_category}. {reason, select, none {} other {Moderator's note: {reason}. }}{evidence, select, none {} other {Passage: {evidence}. }}Edit it and post it again.

Block.Title: Walkthrough did not pass moderation
Block.ReviewContent: Your walkthrough for "{game_title}" did not pass moderation. Reason: {top_category}. {reason, select, none {} other {Moderator's note: {reason}. }}{evidence, select, none {} other {Passage: {evidence}. }}Edit it and publish it again.

Valid.Title: Report accepted
Valid.Content: Your report was confirmed. Violation: {reason}; severity: {malicious_level}.{process_note, select, none {} other { Note: {process_note}}}

Invalid.Title: Report rejected
Invalid.Content: Your report was not confirmed. You have made {false_report_count} invalid report(s) in the last 30 days; repeated invalid reports are penalised.{ban_days, select, none {} other { Your account is banned for {ban_days} day(s).}}{process_note, select, none {} other { Note: {process_note}}}

Penalty.Title: Resource violation notice
Penalty.Content: A resource you uploaded was confirmed as a violation. Violation: {reason}; severity: {malicious_level}.{upload_tier_demoted, select, true { Your upload tier has been lowered.} other {}}{ban_days, select, none {} other { Your account is banned for {ban_days} day(s).}}{process_note, select, none {} other { Note: {process_note}}}

NewReport.Title: New resource report
NewReport.Content: {reporter_name} reported a resource uploaded by {reported_user_name}. Reason: {reason}; severity: {malicious_level}.

RouteSuspended.Title: AI route suspended
RouteSuspended.Content: The model {model} of {provider} ({upstream_id}) was suspended after failed calls.{error_kind, select, none {} other { Error kind: {error_kind}.}}{error_message, select, none {} other { Error: {error_message}}}

RouteRecovered.Title: AI route recovered
RouteRecovered.Content: The model {model} of {provider} ({upstream_id}) is available again

Suspended.Title: API key suspended
Suspended.Content: An administrator suspended your API key "{name}" ({prefix}…); requests made with it are refused. Reason: {reason}

Restored.Title: API key restored
Restored.Content: Your API key "{name}" ({prefix}…) has been restored and can be used again.

reason.BROKEN_OR_TRUNCATED: the file is damaged or incomplete
reason.BROKEN_OR_UNSUPPORTED: the file is damaged or its format is not supported
reason.ENCRYPTED: the archive is encrypted and cannot be checked
reason.INCOMPLETE_SET: the set of volumes is incomplete
reason.ABANDONED: the check of the file could not be completed
reason.COMPOSE_BASE_GONE: the original resource no longer exists or can no longer be used
reason.COMPOSE_BASE_UNREADABLE: the archive of the original cannot be unpacked
reason.COMPOSE_PATCH_UNREADABLE: the archive of the patch cannot be used
reason.COMPOSE_SAVE_UNREADABLE: the archive of the save cannot be unpacked
reason.COMPOSE_PLACE_MISSING: the chosen folder is not among the unpacked files
reason.COMPOSE_NO_ROOM: the server is out of working space
reason.COMPOSE_TOO_LARGE: the unpacked size is over the limit
reason.COMPOSE_HARMFUL: harmful content was detected in the composed file
reason.COMPOSE_BROKEN: the composed archive did not pass the check
reason.COMPOSE_NOTHING_TO_APPLY: nothing in the patch folder goes into the game folder
reason.COMPOSE_PATH_CONFLICT: a file in the patch conflicts with a file or folder of the same name in the original
